{{Quote|The galaxy has changed&mdash;it's ''mine'' for the taking! I will rule the Empire&hellip; I will sit on Palpatine's throne.|Carnor Jax|audio=CarnorJax.flac|<ref name="CE Audio">[[Crimson Empire (audio drama)|''Crimson Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''Crimson Empire''' was a splinter faction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] located in a narrow but long strip from the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] aligned with who had relocated to [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]] from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. [[Imperial Sovereign Protector]] [[Carnor Jax]] seized a narrow of holdings as the proclaimed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] but was never truly acknowledged. The name of the Crimson Empire derived from the color of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] uniform worn by its founder. Jax created a facade of representative [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]], though in reality it served as a rubber-stamp for the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] edicts.

Jax himself was however [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by [[Kir Kanos]], with [[Burr Nolyds]] ascended to power only to be killed himself as part of a plot by [[Nom Anor]], a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who installed [[Xandel Carivus]] as emperor. His rule was short lived, as Kanos killed Carivus while the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Ord Cantrell|captured]] Ord Cantrell.

==History==
The Crimson Empire had its origins in the [[Dark Empire]], a second [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] regime established by the reborn [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10]]-[[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. The [[Imperial Sovereign Protector]] [[Carnor Jax]] supervised the [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] of Palpatine's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] bodies, ensuring the Emperor's final demise. After Palpatine's [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]] at [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], Jax seized control of the Empire, declaring himself Emperor and ruling with the assistance of a twelve-person [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends#The .22Council of Blood.22|Imperial Interim Ruling Council]]. The Council contained a number of aliens on it, the first time in the Empire that aliens had been given such major political positions.<ref name="atlas" />

Although many of the former Empire's military commanders established themselves as independent [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and ignored Jax and the Council, Jax's Crimson Empire represented the last vestige of the centralized Imperial state established by Palpatine.<ref name="atlas" />

Jax himself was killed shortly after by his rival Guardsman, [[Kir Kanos]]. [[Burr Nolyds]] became head of the remnant, but was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] as part of a plot supervised by [[Nom Anor]]. Under Anor's guidance, [[Xandel Carivus]] eventually purged his enemies in the Council, disbanding it and proclaiming himself Emperor. His rule was short lived, as Kanos killed Carivus while the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Ord Cantrell|captured]] the capital of Ord Cantrell, taking the remaining councilors into custody.<ref name="CE2">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood]]''</ref><ref name="HB2">[[Star Wars Handbook 2: Crimson Empire|''Star Wars Handbook'' 2: ''Crimson Empire'']]</ref>

The capture of Ord Cantrell would be the end of the faction. The remaining Imperial warlords recognized no central authority and the remnants of the former Crimson Empire would have little power. This splintered state would last for a year, until [[Natasi Daala]]'s drive for [[Imperial Reunification]] would result in the establishment of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="DS">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>

==Government and politics==
The Crimson Empire, like the Dark Empire before it, had the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] as the head of state. However, it also utilized a twelve-person executive body known as the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends#The .22Council of Blood.22|Imperial Interim Ruling Council]], also nicknamed the "Council of Blood". In contrast to the Galactic Empire, it allowed aliens to serve on the Council. The [[Diet of Imperial Planetary Governors]] was a body established by the Interim Ruling Council to create a facade of representative democracy in the Empire, though in reality it served as a rubber-stamp legitimiser for the Council's edicts.

==Military==
As with other Imperial commanders had become independent warlords in the Deep Core, the Crimson Empire's forces were at a minimum. However, it nonetheless had access to [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]], [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut]]s, [[TIE crawler/Legends|TIE Crawlers]], [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|Chariot LAVs]], [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]], [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] and [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]]. The [[133rd Imperial Fighter Group]] was also among the Crimson Empire. The [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|supreme commanders]] during its time were [[General/Legends|General]] [[Redd Wessel]], General [[Immodet]], and lastly, an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Crimson Empire)|unidentified officer]].

==Astrography==
The Crimson Empire existed in a long strip running from the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], and bordering on the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. Notable worlds under its control included [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]], the [[Kol Huro system/Legends|Kol Huro system]], [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]], [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]], [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]], [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]], and the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]]. Additionally, the support of its alien councilors (specifically the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Ch'Unkk]], [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Za]], [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Manos]], and [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] [[Kooloota-Fyf]]) gave the Crimson Empire isolated pockets of control outside that region.<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The empire that Carnor Jax ran was not actually given a name when the comic series was released. It wasn't until ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' where it was given a name, which was also the same name as the series it originated in. A similar action happened with its predecessor, the [[Dark Empire]].
